title: Cellular colony growth over live HTML
blurb: A live HTML specimen card drawn on one ElementGL WebGL 2 canvas where a ping-pong framebuffer simulation grows cellular colonies from every tap, recolouring typography, checkboxes and buttons underneath.
question: Can a ping-pong framebuffer simulation run on the GPU without pixel readback to grow organic cellular colonies outward from every tap on a live HTML card, recolouring and inverting typography, checkboxes and buttons while every control underneath stays clickable and editable?
result: Measured in headless Chrome 160 Canary (2026-11-27): 5/5 live checks pass (1.14 MP, 9.1 MB at 412 px DPR 2.625); two 192x256 RGBA8 ping-pong FBOs grow ink-guided Voronoi cellular colonies in top-down UV space without pixel readback while keeping checkboxes, inputs and buttons clickable via updateElementGeometry(). Real Android hardware stays not verified.
